summary: 30 calendar days (weekends inside a leave block count); 12 regional + 2 municipal holidays published each autumn; leave expires with the year unless illness/parental leave prevented it.

owner.role: Employment counsel (ES) + HR Business Partner Madrid

locationAssumption.citation: Employees assumed to work in Madrid city (municipality sets 2 local holidays)

rule.citation: Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 38.1: at least 30 calendar days; holidays inside a leave block are counted
rule.note: Many convenios convert to 22 working days — Groupon Spain's applicable convenio must be checked.

source.citation: Comunidad de Madrid 2027 labour calendar decree not yet published in BOCM as of 2026-10-02 (usually late September/October)
source.note: Pack cannot be activated for 2027 until the decree and the Madrid city locals are loaded and signed off.

rule.citation: ET art. 37.2: up to 14 holidays/year (2 local); a holiday on Sunday may be moved by the region
ET art. 38.1: minimum 30 calendar days per year
Proportional to time worked in the year (~2.5 calendar days/month); front-loaded on 1 January (Groupon policy assumption)
ET art. 38.3: leave is taken within the year; exception where incapacity/parental leave overlapped (18 months)
rule.note: The incapacity exception is not modelled.

rule.citation: ET art. 38.3: if incapacity coincides with the leave period, leave can be taken afterwards
ET art. 38.1: leave cannot be replaced by money except on termination (case law)

extras.label: Convenio colectivo
extras.citation: The applicable sector convenio usually defines working-day counting and may add days
extras.note: Request Groupon Spain's convenio before go-live.
